description:
The SoloRock Rockies 8-Speed Folding Bike is built for adventure with larger volume knobby tires and a rear suspension, designed to tackle unexpected fun situations with comfort and ease. With the additional stopping power of Tektro hydraulic disc brakes this version is made to explore more! Its 20" wheels provide a smooth and stable ride, while the folding frame allows for easy storage and transport. Equipped with a 8-speed drivetrain, it offers versatility for both urban commutes and off-road explorations. With added features like a rear rack, fenders, and durable suspension, the SoloRock Rockies is perfect for riders seeking a reliable bike for any terrain or weather condition.
Shipping Included
Derailleur upgraded to 8 Speed Shimano Altus
2025 Version - Rear rack is not included, as per suggestion from customers, but can be ordered / added separately
